top_signal.title: Struggling to get sales on my handmade jewelry website & my social media traffic is reaching the wrong audience—any advice?
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,   I'm an independent beaded jewelry artist, each piece is designed and woven bead by bead by hand. I built my own standalone website (not on Etsy) and have managed to get a handful of orders with great customer feedback, so I know people genuinely love these pieces.   However, I'm really struggling to scale up and get consistent traffic, and I've run into two main roadblocks:      Audience & location mismatch on social media: When I post making-of videos on TikTok/IG, the algorithm keeps pushing my content to regions outside my target shipping market, or mostly attracts fellow DIY hobbyists looking for crafting inspiration rather than actual jewelry buyers in the US/Europe.     Low standalone website traffic: Since I don't have Etsy's built-in marketplace search traffic, relying purely on organic social media feels super slow.      For those of you selling handmade or niche products on your own website:   - How did you train your social media algorithm to reach buyers in your target market?   - What free or low-budget marketing channels actually brought you your first 50–100 orders? (I just started focusing more on Pinterest, hoping that helps!)   Any honest feedback or tips would be hugely appreciated. Thanks in advance!       submitted by     /u/Fantastic-Nerve-1959       [link]       [comments]
